definitions.ask: Should Ctrl-Shift-U keep scrolling the preview up as a second key beside Ctrl-U?
definitions.why: Ctrl-Shift-U only existed because Ctrl-U was taken; dropping it restores the original keymap

choices.label: Unbound again and passed through to search, as before the remember-view change; one key per action
Stays a silent alias for Ctrl-U's half-page-up scroll, documented beside it
